scope: Independent point4 composed code review; no production mutation or certification

findings.description: Media/direct stranica main enters generation at unfinished DB_COMMITTED; legacy guarded publication correctly rejects same state.
findings.required_resolution: One canonical reentrant price quiescence shared by guard publication and direct full rebuild paths.
findings.resolution: Canonical guard owns validated reentrant SQLite lease; all three direct renderer entry boundaries join it after publication fence.

review_passes: Exact composition checks pinned price and dependency byte sets before integrating.
Media entry worker acquires shared publication fence before backup or writes.
Media SQL journal uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE and commits/closes before renderer entry.
Rollback DB uses conditional expected values; file recovery uses no-replace link; cache recovery changes only one vehicle member.
Publication fence fork reset closes inherited descriptor without unlocking parent lease.
Known publication paths use canonical publish_transaction_guard; only stranica is explicitly reloaded.
Direct main/zapisat/obnovit_etalon reject QUEUED and DB_COMMITTED before effect.
Existing publication guard -> main -> file/template wrappers reenter one SQLite lease without self-deadlock.
Renderer exception releases SQLite transaction and TLS; fresh following call succeeds.
Nested lease verifies publication ownership, process/thread, canonical DB inode, active query-only transaction.
Forked child rejected before inherited SQLite context use.
remaining_scope_limits: All forward writes require separate production writer gate to exclude uncooperative/old loaded writers.
Forward photo deletion re-enumerates under cooperative fence; no claim of arbitrary uncooperative writer safety.
Live Stage3/Stage4 and Preview24 applicability belong to other review scopes.
new_validation: Exact composed main wrapper against isolated actual outbox DB at DB_COMMITTED; guard comparison
acceptance_condition: Final saved candidate files must exactly match reviewed_composed_candidate_sha256; no production PASS implied.
